caption: The drawing features three views of a wooden chair rendered in fine black pencil or ink lines on an off-white background. On the left side of the composition is a frontal view of the chair, showing four horizontal stretcher rungs (three between the legs and one connecting the stretchers), three horizontal slats forming the backrest, and two vertical posts with finial knobs at the top. The seat is depicted as woven with a detailed line pattern. In the upper center of the drawing is a top-down plan view illustrating the woven pattern of the seat, which is represented by diagonal and vertical lines converging at the seat’s center, with the four corner posts clearly marked as rounded circles. On the right side, there is a side view of the chair, where two horizontal slats are visible along with the finial-topped posts and the woven seat edge. The composition includes a scale note at the bottom right: “SCALE 2 1/2" = 1’.” The entire drawing uses consistent line weight and shading only for the seat’s weaving, showing a technical perspective and structural details of the chair.
title: Study for Drawing of Chair
